Is our data really safe when we use LLMs like Claude, OpenAI, and Google ?

What happens if AI companies use our data for model training or monetization? Are privacy policies enough, or do we need stronger compliance?

As AI adoption grows, organizations need clear controls around data privacy, consent, retention, access, and regulatory compliance before trusting sensitive data to LLMs.

Today marks the end of Tim Cook’s era at Apple.

He took over from Steve Jobs when Apple was valued at around $350B and helped transform it into a company valued at more than $4T.

Cook didn’t replace Jobs’ vision — he scaled it, evolved it, and turned it into a global powerhouse.

A different leader. A different style. One extraordinary legacy.
